statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Q : Set (Fin n → ℝ)), LipschitzWith ⟨Real.sqrt (n : ℝ), Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩ (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin n → ℝ) → GP.Space n) → Metric.ediam Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal h → Metric.ediam (WithLp.toLp 2 '' Q : Set (GP.Space n)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * h)
proof:
intro h Q hL hQ
let L : ℝ≥0 := ⟨Real.sqrt (n : ℝ), Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩
have he : (L : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) := ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal.symm
calc
  Metric.ediam (WithLp.toLp 2 '' Q : Set (GP.Space n)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) * Metric.ediam Q := by
    change LipschitzWith L _ at hL
    simpa only [he] using hL.ediam_image_le Q
  _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) * ENNReal.ofReal h := mul_le_mul_left' hQ _
  _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * h) := (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).symm
